content.title: Is Taylor Frankie Paul Pregnant? Breaking Down the 'Secret Lives of Mormon Wives' Season 4 Cliffhanger
content.text: NEED TO KNOW The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives season 4 concludes with the suggestion that a member of MomTok is pregnantThe fourth season is the first season in the show's history where one of the cast members isn't pregnantThe Secret Lives of Mormon Wives season 4 is now available to stream on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ Could MomTok survive another baby on the way? The season 4 finale of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives asks just that, as it's revealed that not only did Taylor Frankie Paul and Dakota Mortensen hook up again before she left for The Bachelorette, but that Taylor was dropping some hints that they might be in another familiar situation. The night before The Bachelorette, Dakota goes to drop off Ever but ends up spending the night, throwing the morning into disarray and concerning Taylor's family and MomTok that she wouldn't follow through on the opportunity. Taylor does leave, but Dakota persists. The two FaceTime when she's traveling from the airport to the location where she'd be filming. Dakota asks Taylor to "save a rose" for him, but later claims he didn't have time to ask her a very important question. Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer​​, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories. Related Stories Dakota pulls Jessi and Jordan aside at their Halloween party, where he reveals that Taylor was hinting that she could be pregnant before she left. Referencing that this was the second time while filming season 4 that the two had hooked up, Dakota says, "Taylor told me the last time that we did it that she was like ovulating." "Taylor, randomly in bed, she goes, 'I haven't had my period yet,' and I'm like, 'What, from when?' And then she told me, and I was like, 'Whoa, hang on,' " he claims. "They took her damn phone before I could ask her like, 'Hey, did you start your period or what's going on?' " Dakota continued. They debate the possibility, and Jessi was amazed that Taylor would allegedly find herself in this situation. "Deep down, you have symptoms. You know if you're pregnant." "Then I was trying to think about how emotional she's been lately," he says, to which Jessi agrees that Taylor has been "a little erratic." Jessi then says, "Can you f---ing imagine, you guys? Like she's the Bachelorette and she's pregnant. That's never happened. I don't think they could keep her on for that. " "I'm scared to death. I don't know if she's pregnant," Dakota concludes. The season's last scene shows Taylor being asked by producers about the possibility of being pregnant, leaving it as a cliffhanger. The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives season 4 is now available to stream on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.
